brief.rationale: The loss date of 2026-04-12 falls within the policy period of 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01. The base declarations set a $1,000,000 Per-Occurrence limit and refer to executed endorsements. Endorsement GL-105 is executed and countersigned, matches the policy number and named insured, and has been effective since 2026-01-01. It raises the limit to $2,000,000, and no other endorsement supersedes or revokes it. The broker note only corroborates GL-105. The marketing brochure confers no coverage. The claim notice only confirms the insured, the date and the loss description. The packet has no coverage forms, exclusions or location schedule, so it cannot confirm that the ammonia-related third-party inventory damage is covered under the full policy form. The packet shows no exclusion for this loss. The $25,000 base deductible in the declarations (line 6) is unchanged by GL-105.
